arguments.code:
from collections import Counter

# Build frequency across all artists listed for each recommended song
artist_counts=Counter()
first_seen_order={}
order=0
for song in all_recs:
    for a in song.get('artists', []):
        name=a.get('name')
        if name is None:
            continue
        artist_counts[name]+=1
        if name not in first_seen_order:
            first_seen_order[name]=order
            order+=1

print('unique_artists', len(artist_counts))
print('top_counts', artist_counts.most_common(10))

# Determine max frequency with tie-breaker: lowest first_seen_order, then alphabetical
max_freq=max(artist_counts.values())
candidates=[name for name,cnt in artist_counts.items() if cnt==max_freq]
print('max_freq', max_freq, 'candidates', candidates)

candidates_sorted=sorted(candidates, key=lambda n: (first_seen_order[n], n))
selected=candidates_sorted[0] if candidates_sorted else None
print('selected_artist', selected)
